result.summary: The page is largely well-designed, but one restaurant title in the 'Popular right now' section is truncated with a hard character cut-off ('Tokumaru Rameı'), which looks visually broken rather than a clean ellipsis truncation.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Tokumaru Rameı' is cut off mid-word at the right edge without an ellipsis, making the title look broken/garbled (the final letter appears clipped, e.g. 'Rameı' instead of 'Ramen').
issues.suggestion: Apply text truncation with an ellipsis (text-overflow: ellipsis) or allow the title to wrap to a second line so the full restaurant name 'Tokumaru Ramen' is readable.
